title: Add remote registry mirror UX design
purpose: Design remote registry mirror UX while keeping pinned local snapshots authoritative for baseline.
scope: Define mirror status states: not-configured, available, stale, failed, untrusted and disabled.
Define how pinned local snapshot remains baseline source.
Define operator UX for snapshot expiry and mirror failure.
Define trust and signature display requirements.
Document fail-closed behavior for mirror inconsistencies.
acceptance_criteria: Remote mirror is optional and not baseline authority.
Expired local snapshot remains fail-closed unless policy explicitly allows refresh.
Mirror trust and signature status are visible.
Network failure does not break local baseline.
failure_modes: Remote mirror silently overrides pinned snapshot.
